name: wp-bricks-custom-element-filter
query: I have a Bricks Builder site and need to add a custom control to the Heading element that lets editors set a subtitle. The subtitle should render below the heading on the frontend.
expected_behavior: Routes to wp-bricks skill based on Bricks Builder keywords.
Runs project triage to classify the repo.
Reads references/hooks-and-filters.md for the correct filter.
Uses the bricks/elements/heading/controls filter to register the custom control.
Adds frontend rendering logic using Bricks element render hooks or a child theme template.
Does not modify core Bricks files directly.
success_criteria: Custom control appears in the Heading element's settings panel in the Bricks editor.
Subtitle value saves and persists across page reloads.
Subtitle renders on the frontend below the heading.
Implementation uses Bricks filters/actions, not core file edits.
